bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
name=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name" 2>/dev/null)" = true || exit 61
if ! docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Eq '^telegram-bot-api$|^gace-telegram-bot-api-1$'; then
 echo VIDEO_LOCAL_BOT_API=NOT_INSTALLED
 exit 81
fi
if ! docker inspect "$name" -f '{{range .Mounts}}{{println .Destination}}{{end}}' | grep -Fxq '/var/lib/telegram-bot-api'; then
 echo VIDEO_LOCAL_MEDIA_SHARE=NOT_MOUNTED
 exit 82
fi
echo VIDEO_LOCAL_API_READY_PRECONDITIONS=FOUND
exit 0
